clauses.title: Scope – Requirements and
clauses.text: 1. Scope - Requirements and the methods of sampling and test for sprayed mineral wool thermal insulation.

clauses.title: Mineral Wool
clauses.text: 2.1 Mineral Wool  - Mineral wool conforming to IS 3677 : 1985* shall be used.

clauses.title: Sprayable Mineral Wool –
clauses.text: 2.2 Sprayable Mineral Wool - Mineral wool with suitable binder, uniformly blended to ensure that it does not separate during  normal handling and spraying operations shall be used.

clauses.title: Density – The density
clauses.text: 3.1 Density - The density of the applied and dried material shall be in the range of 200 to 250 kg/m3 and shall also not vary by more than ±15 percent from the value declared by the manufacturer.

clauses.title: Compressive Strength
clauses.text: 3.2 Compressive Strength Deformation Compresive Strength, Percent Min Pa (N/m2) 10 4 550 15 6 460

clauses.title: Thermal Conductivity
clauses.text: 3.3 Thermal Conductivity Mean Thermal Temperature Conductivity, Max ºC W/mK 100 0.066 150 0.072 200 0.079 250 0.085 370 0.101

clauses.title: Heat Resistance – Shall
clauses.text: 3.4 Heat Resistance - Shall not suffer visible deterioration of the fibrous structure when tested by heating to 600ºC.

clauses.title: Incombustibility – Shall be
clauses.text: 3.5 Incombustibility - Shall be found to be incombustible.

clauses.title: Fire Protection
clauses.text: 3.6 Fire Protection  -   When the material is to be used for fire protection purposes, it shall satisfy the heating conditions (time-temperature curve) as specified in IS 3809 : 1979** for determination of fire resistance rating.

clauses.title: Thickness
clauses.text: 3.7 Thickness  - The thickness of finished, sprayed-on insulation shall not vary from the nominal value by more than +10 mm -3 mm for thickness up to 100 mm and by - 5 +15 percent for the thickness above 100 mm.

clauses.title: Corrosion Protection – Shall
clauses.text: 3.8 Corrosion Protection - Shall not corrode the surface on which it is applied.

clauses.title: Resistance to Vibration –
clauses.text: 3.9.1 Resistance to Vibration -  Shall show not more than 1 percent by height of settlement.

clauses.title: Resistance to Jolting –
clauses.text: 3.9.2 Resistance to Jolting -  Shall show not more than 3 percent by height of settlement. ** Fire resistance test for structures (first revision). * Unbonded rock and slag wool for thermal insulation (second revision) Note - For methods of tests, refer to IS 3144 : 1992 Mineral wool thermal insulation materials methods of tests (second revision), IS 3346 : 1980 Methods of determination of thermal conductivity of thermal insulation materials (two slab guarded hot plate method) (first revision), IS 5688 : 1982 Methods of test for preformed block -type and pipe covering type thermal insulation (first revision) and IS 5724 : 1970 Methods of tests for thermal insulating cements. For detailed information, refer to IS 9742 : 1993  Specifications for sprayed mineral wool thermal insulation (first revision).
